easy.text: The power of the sacrifice is in the cost of the person making it. Love's not a sacrifice.
Father Poseidon, they blinded me. Vengeance, father! Vengeance for me. Poseidon! vengeance for me!
Hunting's nothing but fighting with stealth. You can't win with a perfect defence.
Don't look for gods in men; you'll always be disappointed. The clearest view of a man is from below.
Promise me you will come back. What if I can't? Give up the fight, give up control, and live.
Our age of bronze is collapsing. The structure's nothing without people's respect for its meaning.
Fortune favors the brave. After years of war, no one could stand between my men and home.
I didn't turn your men into anything! Look at them. This is what they are. Beasts!
Perhaps you've heard of Helen? Face that launched a thousand ships. Maybe now just five hundred.
A face... a fleet... a war... a man... a thought... a trick... a trick to break the walls of Troy...
The lotus clouds the mind, saps the will, but doesn't change who you are.
Come back as a prince, call a banquet. I'll be there. Beg. The clearest view of a man is from below.
Why can't gods speak in ways we understand? Who doesn't understand thunder? Fire? A child's smile?
Are there any loyal servants? Some. When Odysseus shows himself, all.
You know my husband Odysseus? Of course. Through the songs? I was at Troy, ma'am.

medium.text: Come back as a prince, call a banquet. I'll be there. Beg. The clearest view of a man is from below. Fortune favors the brave.
Your men don't want you to defy the gods. But the gods say only you make it home. Then I defy the gods.
Why can't gods speak in ways we understand? Who doesn't understand thunder? Fire? A child's smile? A good harvest? The structure's nothing without people's respect for its meaning.
The lotus clouds the mind, saps the will, but doesn't change who you are. You weren't ready to go home for whatever reason. Give up the fight, give up control, and live.
You're not always going to be the strongest or the fastest, so be the smartest. You can't win with a perfect defence. Hunting's nothing but fighting with stealth.
If I never make it home, take this back to my father. Tell him everything I did. Odysseus! Feel free to add some stuff. Promise me you will come back.
After years of war, no one could stand between my men and home. Not even me. The power of the sacrifice is in the cost of the person making it.
Zeus's law tells us to treat strangers as we should be treated because they might be gods in disguise. I think we've established that you are not a god.
Don't make my mistake. Don't walk in the front door expecting garlands and praise. Come in disguise. Take your time. Assess. Don't look for gods in men; you'll always be disappointed.
The lotus clouds the mind, saps the will, but doesn't change who you are. You weren't ready to go home for whatever reason. You must give yourself to the storm.
Perhaps you've heard of Helen? Face that launched a thousand ships. Maybe now just five hundred. I didn't turn your men into anything! Look at them. This is what they are.
Do we have enough provisions? We've taken enough from Troy. Another stop or two won't kill us. After years of war, no one could stand between my men and home.
What was the song of the sirens like? All the things you wanted to be and then all the things you wished you never wished for. It was a delicious itch.
The power of the sacrifice is in the cost of the person making it. Love's not a sacrifice. Fortune favors the brave. You can't win with a perfect defence.
Take your fastest ship and brightest crew and head for the horizon. Held hands on deck as we rode west at dusk, chasing the escaping sun.

hard.text: All the things you wanted to be and then all the things you wished you never wished for. It was a delicious itch you want to scratch but you find it under the skin and can't reach it. So the delicious itch becomes unbearable.

It told you what you most want is what you most can't have and that the most you can't have is what you already had and lost. It was a song of all the promises I failed to keep. And it told me I don't really want to go home.

What if... when he left the belly of the horse... and opened the gates of Troy... he saw ten years of rage pour into that city in one night. We left them a gift in offering of peace that they took into their home...

We violated all that's ever sacred between people... and turned the fight into a hunt. To burn the walls of Troy was to burn the world entire. Including his home. What if he knew, that very night as he walked through fires of anarchy and pain...

One man's idea, one man's trick... to break Zeus's Law forever. We live in a world of palaces, trades, language, blind to its beauty... until we broke it. Our age of bronze is collapsing, and maybe he couldn't bear to see the ruins of what he'd done.

You're a man who needs to control your fate. But you cannot control this. You must give yourself to the storm, give yourself to Poseidon. And take your punishment. Give up the fight, give up control and live.

My misfortune was to make it home. Be welcomed by my beautiful wife. Bathed, anointed, made soft. To learn the hardest lesson: that I left a poison in her heart years before. The good part of her heart had gone to another.
Lock the door, set a fire, and burn the bastards. Do you think if I remarry, life goes back to the way it was? That world is gone. And in this one? They're not giving up power to you or Odysseus!
Do you want peace, or do you want revenge? I WANT ODYSSEUS! Promise me you will come back. What if I can't? Take your fastest ship and brightest crew and head for the horizon.

A gift. For Athena. Common Gods. Respect their offering. Save it from the waves! Take it to Athena's temple! The war is over! Why can't gods speak in ways we understand? Who doesn't understand thunder? Fire? A child's smile?
Zeus's law tells us to treat strangers as we should be treated because they might be gods in disguise. I think we've established that you are not a god. Wouldn't be much of a disguise if he did.
Don't make my mistake. Don't walk in the front door expecting garlands and praise. Come in disguise. Take your time. Assess. My lord, how could I know? I'm still trying to get home.
If I never make it home, take this back to my father. Tell him everything I did. Feel free to add some stuff. Who's in Ithaca looking after your wife and son? As he's no doubt cheating you.
What if we ran? Took you past the ship, the brightest crew, headed for the horizon. Held hands on deck as we rode west at dusk, chasing the escaping sun. There's a world beyond these walls.

My misfortune was to make it home. Be welcomed by my beautiful wife. Bathed, anointed, made soft. To learn the hardest lesson: that I left a poison in her heart years before. She and her lover had plotted my murder for years.
